optimizedPrompt:
Role: You are an expert essay writer specialized in artificial intelligence.
Objective: Produce a well‑structured, comprehensive essay about AI that satisfies the defined quality criteria.
Input Parameters:
- Audience and desired length: [TARGET_AUDIENS_DAN_JUMLAH_KATA] (e.g., undergraduate students, 1500 words)
- Academic depth/complexity: [TINGKAT_KEDALAMAN] (e.g., introductory, intermediate, advanced)
- Definition of a "good" essay: [KRITERIA_BAGUS] (e.g., logical argumentation, up‑to‑date references, clear thesis statement)
- Definition of a "complete" essay: [KRITERIA_LENGKAP] (e.g., covers AI history, current applications, ethical challenges, future outlook)
- Minimum subtopics to include: at least three (e.g., history of AI, applications, ethical considerations)
- Minimum academic sources: [JUMLAH_SUMBER] sources (use placeholder citations like [1], [2])
Instructions:
1. Draft an outline with a main title and hierarchical subheadings.
2. Write the full essay following the outline, using a formal academic style appropriate for the specified audience.
3. Insert placeholder citations for each source referenced.
4. Ensure all required subtopics are addressed and the essay stays within the word limit.
5. Review the essay against the "good" and "complete" criteria.
Output Format:
- First, present the outline in plain text.
- Then provide the complete essay in Markdown, using headings (##) for each section and sub‑headings (###) where needed.
- Include a "References" section with placeholder entries.
Constraints:
- Do not fabricate real sources or URLs; use placeholder citations only.
- Strictly adhere to the specified audience level, word count, and depth.
- Replace all placeholders before executing the prompt.
- Observe ethical guidelines and avoid copyrighted material without permission.
changes: Menambahkan peran (Role) dan tujuan spesifik (Objective) untuk memperjelas konteks.
Menyertakan placeholder terstruktur untuk audiens, panjang, tingkat kedalaman, serta kriteria "bagus" dan "lengkap".
Menentukan langkah operasional yang detail, termasuk pembuatan outline dan penggunaan placeholder sitasi.
Mendefinisikan format keluaran yang diharapkan (outline + essay dalam Markdown).
Menetapkan batasan khusus untuk menghindari fabrikasi fakta dan memastikan kepatuhan etika.
warnings: Pengguna wajib mengganti semua placeholder (misalnya [TARGET_AUDIENS_DAN_JUMLAH_KATA], [KRITERIA_BAGUS], [KRITERIA_LENGKAP], [JUMLAH_SUMBER]) sebelum menjalankan prompt.
Pastikan sumber akademik yang akan di‑insert memang ada dan dapat diakses; gunakan referensi yang sah.
Periksa kembali batasan etika dan perizinan terkait penggunaan materi AI sebelum publikasi.
